Pro Wrestling.name: Pro Wrestling
Pro Wrestling.summary:
Pro Wrestling is a professional wrestling video game released for the Sega Master System in 1986 by Sega. It centers around tag team wrestling, with four duos that players can select and guide to various championship titles around the world.

Pro Wrestling is a localised version of Gokuaku Doumei Dump Matsumoto for the Sega Master System, released for the console in 1986.

Pro Wrestling replaces female wrestlers of Gokuaku Doumei Dump Matsumoto with fictional male fighters.

Trivial Pursuit - Genus Edition.name: Trivial Pursuit: Genus Edition
Trivial Pursuit - Genus Edition.summary: Trivial Pursuit is the world's greatest and best selling board game. This Sega version incorporates everything that has helped make it so. Plus, Russell your animated and friendly question master, superb sound and color, wonderful screen background and over 2,000 brain teasing questions.
